{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("\nNumber of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Number of total rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch units
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("\nUnique severity levels:", df['severity'].unique())
print("\nUnique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("\nUnique sexes:", df['sex'].unique())

# Check if treatment arm is non-randomized and associated with severity
print("\nDistribution of severity by arm:")
print(df.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
